about.title: IT Specialist & Front-End Developer
about.description: I'm Mohammadmehdi Fard (Payam Fard), an IT Specialist and Front-End Developer with a B.Sc. in Computer Engineering – Information Technology. I have hands-on experience in modern web development using JavaScript, React.js, Next.js and Tailwind CSS, as well as IT support, network infrastructure, rack equipment, switch configuration, VLAN implementation and IP-based CCTV systems. My experience in technical, industrial and project-based environments has strengthened my skills in software development, troubleshooting, problem-solving and practical technical implementation.
